## Number of Large Storms Indicator

data from the University of Manitoba

https://canwin-datahub.ad.umanitoba.ca/data/dataset/nsidc-extratropical-cyclone-tracking-cnect/resource/baad0eac-5990-4de7-b23b-f5b5f22aafed University of Manitoba Northern Hemisphere Cyclone Dataset 1950-2022 (updated yearly)

```{r}
setwd('/Users/nyelab/Desktop/NYB Indicators/')
cyclones1 <- read.csv('Cyclones/2022/01/System13_2R_202201_673.csv', header = TRUE)
cyclones1 <- cyclones1[1, ]

mos <- c('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12')

for (i in 1950:2022){
  for (j in mos){
    setwd(paste0('/Users/nyelab/Desktop/NYB Indicators/Cyclones/',as.character(i), '/',j,'/'))
    my_files <- list.files(pattern = '\\.csv$')
    cyclones <- lapply(my_files, read.csv)
    all_cyclones<-do.call(rbind, cyclones)
    step1 <- all_cyclones[all_cyclones$lon >= -77, ]
    step2 <- step1[step1$lon <= -67, ]
    step3 <- step2[step2$lat <= 43, ]
    cyclones_nyb <- step3[step3$lat >= 37, ]
    cyclones1 <- rbind(cyclones1, cyclones_nyb)
  }
}
row.names(cyclones1) <- NULL
cyclones <- cyclones1[2:11795,]
row.names(cyclones) <- NULL
```
```{r}
cyclones$strength = 0
for (i in 1:11794){
  if (is.na(cyclones$DsqP[i]) == FALSE){
    if (cyclones$DsqP[i] < 15){
        cyclones$strength[i] = 1}
    if (cyclones$DsqP[i] >= 15){
        cyclones$strength[i] = 2}
  }
}

cyclones_NYB <- cyclones[cyclones$strength > 0, ]

setwd('/Users/nyelab/Desktop/NYB Indicators/NYB_Indicators_Calculations/Final_Timeseries_Figures/Timeseries_Files_2023/')
write.csv(cyclones_NYB, 'Cyclones_2023.csv')
```
